title: Code analysis baseline: findings the team has accepted

code.description: Rule code, for readers of the file.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted for now.

sha256.description: evidenceDigest.sha256 when accepted; if the evidence later differs, the finding is shown for re-review.

externalReviewDigest.description: The imported source claim and its rule context when accepted. Separate from source-only sha256; changing either requires re-review.
